text_en: The same thing occurred in Iconium, where Paul and Barnabas went into the Jewish synagogue and spoke in such a way that a great number of both Jews and Greeks became believers.
text_cn: 他们在依科尼雍，还是照样进犹太人的会堂讲道，以致有很多犹太人和希腊人信从了。

text_en: But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles and poisoned their minds against the brothers.
text_cn: 那些固执不信的犹太人，却挑拨并刺激外邦人的心，来相反弟兄们。

text_en: So they remained for a long time, speaking boldly for the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace by granting signs and wonders to be done through them.
text_cn: 他们在那里逗留了一些日子，依赖主放心大胆地讲道。主为证明他们所宣讲的恩宠的话是真实的，藉他们的手显了征兆和奇迹。

text_en: But the residents of the city were divided; some sided with the Jews, and some with the apostles.
text_cn: 城中的群众就分裂了：有的支持犹太人，有的支持宗徒。

text_en: And when an attempt was made by both Gentiles and Jews, with their rulers, to mistreat them and to stone them,
text_cn: 当外邦人和犹太人连同他们的官长蓄意侮辱他们，和用石头砸死他们的时候，

text_en: the apostles learned of it and fled to Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and to the surrounding country;
text_cn: 他们一听说，就逃往吕考尼雅的吕斯特辣、德尔贝两座城和周围的地方去了，

text_en: and there they continued proclaiming the good news.
text_cn: 在那里传扬福音。

text_en: In Lystra there was a man sitting who could not use his feet and had never walked, for he had been crippled from birth.
text_cn: 在吕斯特辣有一个人，患软脚病，常坐着，由母胎中即是跛子，总没有行走过。

text_en: He listened to Paul as he was speaking. And Paul, looking at him intently and seeing that he had faith to be healed,
text_cn: 这人听保禄讲道；保禄注目看他，见他有信心，可得痊愈，

text_en: said in a loud voice, “Stand upright on your feet. ” And the man sprang up and began to walk.
text_cn: 便大声说道：“直直地站起来！”这人遂跳起来行走。

text_en: When the crowds saw what Paul had done, they shouted in the Lycaonian language, “The gods have come down to us in human form! ”
text_cn: 群众看见保禄所行的，就大声用吕考尼雅话说：“神取了人形，降到我们这里了！”

text_en: Barnabas they called Zeus, and Paul they called Hermes, because he was the chief speaker.
text_cn: 他们遂称巴尔纳伯为则乌斯，称保禄为赫尔默斯，因为他是主要发言人。

text_en: The priest of Zeus, whose temple was just outside the city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates; he and the crowds wanted to offer sacrifice.
text_cn: 在城关的则乌斯的司祭，就带着公牛与花圈来到大门前，要同群众一起献祭。

text_en: When the apostles Barnabas and Paul heard of it, they tore their clothes and rushed out into the crowd, shouting,
text_cn: 巴尔纳伯和保禄宗徒听说这事，就撕裂了自己的衣服， 跑到群众中，喊着，

text_en: “Friends, why are you doing this? We are mortals just like you, and we bring you good news, that you should turn from these worthless things to the living God, who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all that is in them.
text_cn: 说道：“人哪！你们这是作什么？我们也是人啊！与你们有同样的性情；我们只是给你们传扬福音，为叫你们离开这些虚无之物，归依生活的天主，是他创造了天地海洋和其中的一切。

text_en: In past generations he allowed all the nations to follow their own ways;
text_cn: 他在过去的世代，容忍了万民各行其道；

text_en: yet he has not left himself without a witness in doing good—giving you rains from heaven and fruitful seasons, and filling you with food and your hearts with joy. ”
text_cn: 但他并不是没有以善行为自己作证，他从天上给你们赐了雨和结实的季节，以食物和喜乐充满你们的心。”

text_en: Even with these words, they scarcely restrained the crowds from offering sacrifice to them.
text_cn: 说了这些话，才算阻住了群众，没有向他们献祭。

text_en: But Jews came there from Antioch and Iconium and won over the crowds. Then they stoned Paul and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
text_cn: 却有些犹太人，从安提约基雅和依科尼雍来，挑唆群众；群众用石头砸了保禄，以为他死了，就把他拉到城外。

text_en: But when the disciples surrounded him, he got up and went into the city. The next day he went on with Barnabas to Derbe.
text_cn: 但门徒们一围到他跟前，他就起来进了城，第二天同巴尔纳伯起身往德尔贝去了。

text_en: After they had proclaimed the good news to that city and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, then on to Iconium and Antioch.
text_cn: 他们向那城传扬福音，使许多人成为门徒，以后回到吕斯特辣、依科尼雍和安提约基雅，

text_en: There they strengthened the souls of the disciples and encouraged them to continue in the faith, saying, “It is through many persecutions that we must enter the kingdom of God. ”
text_cn: 到处坚固门徒的心，鼓励他们坚持信仰，说我们必须经过许多困难，才能进入天主的国。

text_en: And after they had appointed elders for them in each church, with prayer and fasting they entrusted them to the Lord in whom they had come to believe.
text_cn: 二人在各教会给他们选立了长老，在祈祷禁食以后，把他们托付于他们所信仰的主。

text_en: Then they passed through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.
text_cn: 以后，他们又经过丕息狄雅来到旁非里雅，

text_en: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.
text_cn: 在培尔革宣讲道理以后，下到阿塔肋雅，

text_en: From there they sailed back to Antioch, where they had been commended to the grace of God for the work that they had completed.
text_cn: 又从那里乘船赴安提约基雅。他们原来是从那里被托于天主的恩宠，作现在已完成的工作。

text_en: When they arrived, they called the church together and related all that God had done with them, and how he had opened a door of faith for the Gentiles.
text_cn: 他们一到，就聚集会众，报告天主偕同他们所行的一切大事，和怎样给外邦人打开了信德的门。

text_en: And they stayed there with the disciples for some time.
text_cn: 二人就在那里同门徒们住了不少时日。
